name: SamurAI Shield :: Linux yum/dnf targeted package update (RHEL-like)
description: Input contract for playbooks/linux_yum_targeted_package_update_with_evidence.yml (repo: prfsouto/samurai-aap-playbooks). Updates ONLY the packages named in PACKAGES (never a full-system update). HOSTNAMES is auto-filled by SamurAI Shield from the governed asset and hidden from the operator form. IMPORTANT: enable 'Prompt on launch -> Extra variables' (ask_variables_on_launch) on the Job Template so the engine's governed HOSTNAMES (space-separated multi-host wave) overrides the survey's blank default instead of being discarded.

spec.question_description: Single host, IP, or space/comma-separated list. Filled automatically by SamurAI Shield from the selected asset — do not type it by hand.

Comma-separated package NAMES to update, e.g. httpd or httpd,mod_ssl. Plain names only: globs and wildcards are rejected. Packages not installed on the host fail the run (this playbook updates, it never installs).
Check lists the available updates for the named packages without changing anything. Apply runs yum/dnf update restricted to the named packages.
true lets the playbook reboot the target after Apply, and only when a reboot is required (needs-restarting -r).
Base directory on the target where the structured evidence files are written.
